{{Quote|Urartu says, no humans or Droids allow. It's a house rule of the Contumely Club, I'm afraid.|The creature translates for Urartu|<ref name="RPG" />}}
The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] [[Urartu]] worked with a '''small sentient creature''' who sat on his shoulder and translated his [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. When [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] attempted to enter the establishment, the creature told him that no [[Human/Legends|Humans]] or [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were allowed inside the club.<ref name="RPG" />
